Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1975
ACT III OF 1975
INCOME-TAX
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act further to
amend the Income-tax Act, 1922
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament received the assent of the
President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby published for general,
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the: Income-tax (Amendment) Act,
1974.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the eleventh day of May 1972.

Amendment of section 4, Act XI of 1922

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act further to
amend the Income-tax Act, 1922
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament received the assent of the
President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby published for general,
information :-
2. Amendment of section 4, Act
XI of 1922.----In the Income-tax Act, 1922 (XI of 1922), in section 4, in
subsection (1), in Explanation 6, in the proviso, for clause (i) the following
shall be substituted, namely :-
"(i) in pursuance of a
contract, other than a contract for the export of goods in consequence of a
barter agreement between Pakistan and any other country, in which the bills of
exchange have been drawn in Pakistan rupees; or".
